question: The Golden Revolution in Indian agricultural sector is related with:
solution:
The correct answer is__** horticulture.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Golden Revolution in the Indian agricultural sector is related to horticulture.**
 
• The Golden Revolution is related to **Horticulture and Honey.**
 
• It started in** 1991 and lasted till 2003.**
 
• **Father of Golden Revolution: Nirpakh Tutaj.**
